license: Academic research use; acknowledge BCS Database and its original papers. Do not redistribute raw images in a combined dataset; no commercial use.
group_rule: Numeric filename prefix before the first underscore; reconcile count with 29 groups stated by the official database
reference: Retain BCS1 and BCS2 exactly; native regression target = arithmetic mean of the two scores, reported with inter-rater absolute differences
scale: Native dairy-cow scale; no conversion to the source beef-cattle score categories
preprocessing: Original RGB image converted to RGB and aspect-preserving bilinear letterbox to 160x160; no manual anatomical-point crop, no depth input
source_replication: All three source animal-group folds and all three source seeds; no source checkpoint selected on target test performance
target_calibration: Frozen representation, L2-normalised mean features, ridge regression; alpha chosen in [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] by target inner-validation MAE only
clipping: Predicted target score clipped to [1,5], fixed without inspecting test outcomes
primary_comparison: RGB_rgbd_prototype versus RGB_gaussian, RGB_rgb_prototype and RGB_CE on native target-score MAE
interpretation: Supervised frozen-representation transfer to a second data source, with target labels used for calibration; not zero-shot external validation of the original scoring head
uncertainty: Paired target-animal cluster bootstrap of source-replicate-averaged absolute errors; source seeds and folds are not additional target animals
selection_rule: Retain all registered representations and target folds regardless of results
